title: AppError Enum
description: Unified error type for orchestrator operations with variants for manifest, I/O, TOML parsing, versioning, git, plugins, windows, terminals, and more.
signature: pub enum AppError { ManifestNotFound(String), Io { path: String, source: io::Error }, Toml { path: String, source: toml::de::Error }, ... }
semantics: Represents all failure states the orchestrator can encounter with human-readable messages.
